question: In a patient with asthma symptoms, diagnostic confirmation of the disease will be made first by:

options.opa: The finding of a reversible obstruction of air flow in spirometry.
options.opc: An increase in the number of eosinophils in the induced sputum.
options.opd: The elevation of nitric oxide in exhaled air (FENO).
options.ope: The presence of a specific IgE in blood to an aeroallergen.
